title: Two-word sweeper 1RB---_1LC0RF_0RA0LD_1LE1LA_1RF0LF_0LC0RA: one law for every layered layout, in Lean
text: The extra words between Z and R are a chain of items, each a pair of binary words Q and P. A wrap of Z sends one unit down the chain; a unit adds 3 to Q, every wrap of Q adds 3 to P, every wrap of P sends a unit on, so each separator multiplies a carry by 3. Proved in Lean for every number of items and every width; all 1,169,737 consecutive full events of a 3·10<sup>8</sup>-step run in a layout follow it. Only the 7 overflows of the last word R remain undecoded, the one place a halt could come from.
